resources.string: A binary copy keeps edits separate and leaves the current session open on the source. Managed binaries are copied automatically when saving a separate project; without a copy, the saved project uses the original external file.
This will not switch the current session. Open the new project from Saved Projects when you want to work on it.
Saving does not include pending patches. They stay in this session. To keep them separately, use Export patched copy in Patches.
Saved separately. The current session did not switch. Open the new project from Saved Projects.
Saved separately. The current session did not switch, and pending patches stay here.
Analysis saved. Pending patches were not saved and stay in this session.
